item.title: Bulletin updated at 17:30 HKT 27/Jun/2023
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
An anticyclone aloft will bring mainly fine weather to Guangdong tomorrow. The tropical disturbance now over the Luzon Strait will remain as a relatively weak system in the next couple of days and move across the northern part of the South China Sea. It will edge closer to the coast of southern China on Thursday, bringing showers and thunderstorms to the region. Under the influence of a broad trough of low pressure, the weather will be unsettled over the coast of Guangdong during the weekend and early next week.
